subject: MAP: FinPay stakeholder map + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP draft (FinPay)

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum:

Summary of discovery:
- Goal: Replace existing vendor for inference APIs to reduce latency and bring costs in-house for high-volume payout flows.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q3, production H2 2027.
- Main success criteria: 99th pctl latency < 300ms at 99% of traffic, 20%-$/token cost reduction vs current provider, SOC2 + contractual SLA in place.

Stakeholder map (from our discussion):
- Product lead: Alex Johnson (you) — primary technical decision maker for integration and perf.
- Security/CISO: Samantha Lee — will drive security questionnaire + evidence.
- Procurement: Raj Patel — procurement and contract negotiation.
- Economic buyer / Budget: Elena Gomez (CFO) — final sign-off on pricing and terms.

Proposed MAP (attached: MAP_FinPay_v1.pdf):
1) Security review (SLA & SOC2): Redwood to provide SOC2 evidence + filled questionnaire — target 2 weeks (May 26). Action: Marissa to share evidence and questionnaire.
2) Technical pilot: 2-week pilot on a reserved pool, perf targets and traffic profile to be agreed — target start Jun 15. Action: Alex & Eng to provide sample traffic profile.
3) Pricing & commercials: initial term sheet and committed capacity options — target Jun 30. Action: Raj + Elena loop-in.
4) Contract & PO: finalize SOW and PO — target by Jul 20.

Immediate next steps (for this week):
- I'll send the MAP PDF and SOC2 evidence spreadsheet (attached).
- Alex — please confirm the pilot traffic profile and ideal start week.
- Raj / Samantha — if you want, we can schedule a 30-min security deep-dive next week to walk through the SOC2 evidence and controls.

Thanks — I copied Camila and Rishi to help run the pilot and procurement coordination.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: MAP_FinPay_v1.pdf
Attachment: FinPay_SOC2_evidence_request.xlsx

Subject: Re: Recap + MAP draft (FinPay)

Marissa — really helpful summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Pilot traffic profile: we can provide a 48-hour dump of representative traffic and a 1-week steady-state subset. Target pilot start week of Jun 14 works better for Eng.
2) Security: Samantha is happy to take the initial SOC2 pack; she'd like to schedule the deep-dive on Thu May 20 or Tue May 25 (she's out on Mon).
3) Procurement / pricing: Raj handles procurement; Elena is the final approver but she'll want a short finance note.

I'll confirm with Samantha and Raj on the exact times. For the pilot, can you confirm whether Redwood needs a dedicated GPU pool for pilot telemetry or if a shared pool with token-limited throughput is acceptable? That will change pricing assumptions slightly.

Thanks — copying in Samantha and Raj.

—
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, FinPay
alex.johnson@finpay.com
